docs.summary: Spherical zone of wind shaped like a downwash: air comes down through the middle, spreads out across the ground and dies at the rim. The middle is calm, not the strongest point, which is what makes it read as something hovering rather than a starburst. Terrain grass blends the nearest [`kMaxShaderZones`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.WindZone~kMaxShaderZones) zones per frame, particle systems take the single nearest one.
How many zones one shader can blend at once.
Radius of influence in world units. Wind is zero at and beyond this distance.
Wind force at the center of the zone.
Position-varying jitter on the force, as a fraction of [`WindMain`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.WindZone~WindMain).
Gust amplitude, as a fraction of [`WindMain`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.WindZone~WindMain).
Gusts per second. They roll outward as rings rather than pulsing the whole zone at once.
Every enabled zone in the scene.
Called when the object becomes enabled and active. Only called when the GameObject is in a Scene and enabled.
Called when the object becomes disabled or inactive. Only called when the GameObject was in a Scene and becomes disabled.
Wind velocity this zone applies at a world position, using the current time.

docs.summary: Wind velocity this zone applies at a world position: outflow across the ground plane plus the column coming down through the middle. The grass shader runs the same profile, so a particle and a blade in the same spot are pushed the same way.
